title: UK CAA Consults on Digital Air Traffic Infrastructure
summary: The UK Civil Aviation Authority launched a consultation on its proposed System Wide Information Management approach for aviation information exchange.

title: Boston Dynamics Names Rohit Prasad CEO
summary: Prasad will lead the company's Physical AI strategy to combine robotics and AI for scaling intelligent machines.

title: Flexcompute Simulates Starlab Cabin Airflow
summary: GPU-native computational fluid dynamics modeled full-station airflow and is being extended to track carbon dioxide movement.

title: Logic Fruit Launches FPGA-Based BMC Family for OCP Servers
summary: The L-Nex combines OpenBMC, telemetry, remote KVM, and hardware root of trust in a reconfigurable FPGA SoC.

title: Thermal Complexity Rises in AI Chips and Photonics
summary: Increasing power density makes heat, stress, and aging harder to predict and more critical to address early in design.

title: Semiconductor Sales Reach $1 Trillion Milestone
summary: Semiconductor sales reached $159.7 billion in August 2026, marking significant growth compared to previous months.

title: New Method Fights Gum Disease While Preserving Good Bacteria
summary: Disrupting bacterial communication can push dental plaque toward a healthier microbial balance without destroying beneficial species.

title: Lemmo Introduces Versatile SUV Ebike
summary: Berlin startup Lemmo has announced a versatile SUV ebike designed to offer a comfortable ride for families and adventurous riders.

title: Monolithic 3D Memristor-TFT Stack for Neuromorphic Computing
summary: Researchers published a paper detailing a monolithically integrated memristor-thin-film transistor for electrically programmable multimode reservoir computing.

title: Leisure Travel Vans Reveals Ford Transit Motorhome
summary: Leisure Travel Vans introduced the 2027 Wonder FX motorhome, combining a slide-out wall with a split-recliner Murphy lounge and bed.

title: Programmable Memory Controller Eases DRAM Adoption
summary: Researchers introduced a flexible DRAM interface and memory controller to simplify the adoption of new DRAM techniques.

title: Deposition Sciences Expands Sunshade Tape Offering
summary: Deposition Sciences, Inc. announced a new 12 inch by 30 inch format for its Sunshade thin film coating tape.

title: PEARS Framework for Tactile Robotic Manipulation
summary: Researchers presented PEARS, a physics-prior-guided reinforcement learning framework for sample-efficient online adaptation of tactile robotic policies.

title: Mission-Aware Attestation for Autonomous Systems
summary: Researchers evaluated a runtime assurance contract for time-critical autonomous actions using a hardware-in-the-loop vehicle-to-infrastructure platform.

title: Rapid Fredholm Stabilization for Kuramoto-Sivashinsky Equation
summary: Researchers developed a feedback design for rapid stabilization of the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation using two boundary inputs.

title: VeriFine Framework Scales Verification for Embodied Reasoning
summary: Researchers introduced VeriFine, an agent harness framework that scales verification through the co-evolution of policies, training curricula, and judges.

title: RIS-Assisted Resource Allocation in Upper Mid-Band 6G Networks
summary: This paper investigates a reconfigurable intelligent surface-assisted network operating in the upper mid-band to maximize URLLC reliability under finite blocklength constraints.

title: PhoneBot: An Open Humanoid Robot Platform Using Smartphones
summary: PhoneBot is a low-cost, open-source humanoid robot platform that repurposes commodity smartphones as its primary sensing and computing unit.

title: Benchmark and Communication Framework for Robot Spoken Dialogue
summary: Researchers propose a benchmark and real-time communication framework to explore spoken dialogue artifacts between robots and humans.

title: EgoLAP: Learning from Egocentric Human Data for Robot Control
summary: EgoLAP is a vision-language-action pre-training framework that jointly learns from human and robot trajectories using a shared language-based action chain-of-thought.

title: Robust Scenario-Based Predictive Control for Battery Energy Storage
summary: This study presents the first real-world deployment of scenario-based data-enabled predictive control on a grid-connected battery system to strictly enforce state-of-charge limits.

title: Rydberg Atomic Receivers for Integrated Sensing and Communication
summary: This study examines a multi-branch Rydberg atomic receiver architecture for joint communication and radar sensing by solving the Lindblad master equation.

title: Magnet-Aware Control Framework for Legged Robots
summary: Researchers developed a control framework using model predictive control and whole-body control to compensate for magnetic wrenches acting on legged robots.

title: Fast Non-Parametric Heteroscedastic Imitation Learning with Geometry
summary: This paper proposes a non-parametric imitation learning approach leveraging geometric priors for probabilistic modeling in data-scarce scenarios.

title: Distributed Model-Free Turbine Repositioning for Wind Farms
summary: A model-free method using distributed online optimization is proposed for turbine repositioning control to minimize wake effects in floating offshore wind farms.

title: HygieneRoboBench Benchmarks Household Robot Hygiene Planning
summary: Researchers introduced HygieneRoboBench and Hygiene-NSP to evaluate and improve how household robots plan safe task execution while managing contamination risks and user priorities.

title: RIWANav Framework Improves Urban Navigation via Self-Improvement
summary: RIWANAV is a new post-training framework that uses recursive self-improvement between an action model and a world model to enhance long-horizon urban navigation.

title: Force-Aware Locomotion Enables Quadruped Payload Interactions
summary: A new force-aware locomotion framework allows quadruped robots to maintain stable payload transport while compliantly responding to external physical interactions.

title: CropSentry Multi-Robot System Detects Early Crop Stress
summary: CropSentry is a low-cost, ground-based multi-robot system that uses multimodal leaf sensing and spatial mapping to continuously monitor crop health and detect early stress.

title: CMDS Coordinates Pretrained Diffusion Models via Stochastic Control
summary: Coordinated Multi-Agent Diffusion Steering treats frozen pretrained diffusion models as reusable primitives, coordinating their processes through stochastic optimal control.
